title: Instrument tuning and capo on a part are rejected
description: MNX has no concept of instrument tuning: a part cannot say what its strings sound, so no fret can ever be derived from a pitch. This document writes a standard six-string tuning plus a capo as the flat part-level fields they would naturally be (the exact shape _x.mnxLab.strings/capo drafts) and pins the rejection: the part object refuses unevaluated properties. Without a declared fingerboard the whole derivation ladder of lab/tab-derivation is impossible — this gap is why no instrument is ever assumed.
